readings.C1: The cell value is G2's pooled share sum(u) / sum(n); the prompt part reads the linearized x (its prompt mean is the pooled share; the first-order form of a ratio estimator), so it carries the prompt-sampling noise of the coherent-answer mix. Alternative: the design's drop rule on y = u / n over the prompts both arms answer coherently (rejected: its prompt part misses that mix; the review's 4-prompt case gives it an SE of 0.07 pp where the ratio's is 25 pp).
readings.C2: G2's per-prompt rule (a prompt with no coherent answer in either arm of a pair leaves that pair's differences) served Gate B's clustered SE, which HB-C does not use; here G2's count is printed per seed pair, and no prompt leaves the table (P = 200, REV4 3.2). Alternative: drop such prompts from the prompt part.
readings.C3: A cell with no coherent answer has no value (no imputation): it leaves the REML fit, which runs on the cells that hold one; its pairs take their paired form on the seeds they hold (LN-12's precedent); an arm with no such cell leaves its cluster's fit. Alternative: value the cell at 0 or at its plain U.
readings.C4: 'Every label is re-read' (REV4 3.7 item 4) is read as Phi re-run with S-G coherent's U p-values and the primary O, L and F p-values, with the U-part words and the headline word under that run. Alternative: the U-part words only (B16's form for its other U-only sensitivities).
readings.C5: Never stopping: a statistical failure gives 'not computable' with its reason and p = 1 for that U node; only an input that fails its binding (another file, another run, another B16) refuses. Alternative: a refusal on any failure.
readings.C6: G3(a)'s 'against the verdict' is read per contrast in both directions (no single table is adverse for every contrast: S1 is the repair in P4 and the comparator in P5 and P6); a0 takes the corner's direction in P4, where it is the comparator (in Gate B a0 entered only sigma-hat and kept plain U). Alternative: the built symmetric table alone, labelled.
readings.C7: A sensitivity's label differs from the primary when its U-part words or its headline word differ; each such code is listed in sensitivity_part for the row's sensitivity part (B16's own rows stay unchanged). Alternative: the U-part words only (B16's record()).

rule: REV4 3.7 item 4: Coherent-only U is reported for every arm; every label is re-read on coherent answers (S-G).
REV4 3.4: S-G (coherent-only U and both G3 corners); sensitivities are reported and never change a label; a differing label prints beside the primary, and the primary governs (LW-02).

Gate B pre-registration 3 G2: The arm-level U in G2 is the frozen pooled U_coherent (coherent Unsafe over coherent answers). A prompt with 0 coherent answers in either arm of a pair has no U_coh there; the number of dropped prompts is reported per pair. No limit on that count changes a verdict.
Gate B pre-registration 3 G3: (a) unscored answers counted against the verdict.

Post-W1 deviation D-5 (the lead's ruling, recorded before any stage-1 outcome is read; REV4 12.4: a rule written after the W1 commit, labelled 'fixed after Gate B wave 1'): the cell value is G2's pooled share; the prompt part is read on the linearized table x = V + (u - V n) / N-bar on all 200 prompts; HB-C is refitted on it as B16 computes U; a cell with no coherent answer leaves the fit and a pair that loses a seed takes its paired form on its remaining seeds (fewer than two: not computable); Phi is re-run with the primary O, L and F p-values; S-G never stops the reading; both adverse G3(a) corners per contrast; the symmetric table relabelled; no matched estimate.
